newsitem.title: USA: CS First Boston pays former bankers $4 mln - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston pays former bankers $4 mln - WSJ.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston Corp. paid 33 former investment bankers from its municipal bond operation a total of $4 million to settle a bonus dispute, the Wall Street Journal said in Wednesday's electronic edition, citing people familiar with the matter.
The settlements were confidential and were reached separately with the bankers, who claimed CS First Boston improperly refused to pay them annual bonuses, the paper said.
The bankers were let go when the firm shut its municipal bond unit in 1995, the newspaper said.
The controversy related to a case which raised the question of whether Wall Street firms had to pay bonuses to investment bankers they fired, the Journal said.
CS First Boston and the law firm representing the bankers were quoted by the newspaper as declining to comment on the settlements.
